segments.name: GPU computing platform
products: GPU cluster management and operational services
segments.description: Provides reserved and on-demand GPU compute capacity and GPU cluster management services to AI workloads and AI data center operators.
segments.evidence: The Company manages its business in a centralized manner and operates as a single segment and accordingly has only one operating and reportable segment, the provision of GPU computing platform services.

revenueModel.text: Customers pay for reserved and on-demand access to GPU compute capacity and for GPU cluster management and operational services.
revenueModel.evidence: These services are offered through both on-demand and reserved usage models and are designed to support a range of AI workloads, including large-scale model training, fine-tuning, and high-concurrency inference.
